rule: A block that became all-ages after 2015 is attributed to an SFMTA project when exactly one project's published line geometry covers the block and SFMTA tags the project Bike or its page lists bicycle infrastructure improvements; when several cover it, the one whose name is the block's street, or, when that project's page dates its work to other years, the one whose page dates work to the block's year. A project SFMTA lists in planning or design counts only when its page says the work is complete. The block's year must fall within a year of the years the project's own page dates its construction or installation to. A Slow Street with no project line goes to SFMTA's page for that street, or to a stand-in named from the Slow Streets dataset. Area (polygon) projects are excluded. A resident, school or branch is attributed to the project of the block that first brought it within 0.25 miles.
residents_basis: Census 2020 block population (pop20), at the block's interior point
miles_basis: Row miles per direction row, the Biking and Rolling Plan's unit, as written by tools/bike-network/bike-network-history.py
